raw_text:
PLAN "Couch to 5K — 12 Week Running Starter"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Run 5K"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk-Run Intro 1":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x10..12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x1..2 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walk 1x10..12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x1..2 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Walk-Run Intro 2":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x8..10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x2..3 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walk 1x8..10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x2..3 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Easy Continuous Walk-Run":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x5..8 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x3..4 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walk 1x5..8 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x3..4 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Progressive Walk-Run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x5..8 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x4..5 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walk 1x5..8 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x4..5 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Steady Walk with Short Runs":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x6..8 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x5..6 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walk 1x6..8 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Longer Runs, Controlled Effort":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x4..6 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walk 1x4..6 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Increasing Run Segments":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 1x5..6 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Continuous Run Blocks":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 1x5..6 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Sustain Effort Safely":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x4..6 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x12..14 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 1x4..6 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Consolidation Run":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x14..16 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 1x5..6 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x14..16 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Steady Continuous Run":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x16..18 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Endurance Build":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x18..20 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Run Duration Increase":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x20..22 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 1x5..6 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Controlled Tempo":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x18..20 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 1x5..6 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Sustained Running":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x22..24 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Extended Continuous Run":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x24..26 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Moderate Effort with Walk Breaks":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x12..14 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 1x4..6 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x12..14 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Long Run Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x26..28 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Near Continuous Run":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x28..30 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Sustained Effort with Short Walks":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x20..22 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 1x3..5 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Endurance Run":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x30..32 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Consolidate 5K Pace":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x32..34 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Steady Run with Short Strides":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x18..20 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 1x3..5 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x14..16 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Continuous 5K Simulation":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x30..34 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Slightly Increased Continuous Run":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x34..36 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Recovery Run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x16..18 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Long Slow Distance":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x36..40 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Race Pace Practice":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x30..34 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 1x3..5 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Easy Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x12..14 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full 5K Attempt":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x30..35 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Tapered Run":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x20..24 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Easy Mobilization":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk 1x10..12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          run 1x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Short Easy Run":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x12..14 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Pre-Race Light Run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x12..14 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Very Easy Shakeout":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x8..10 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Race Simulation Easy":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x18..22 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
